directml_complete_ffn.decision: rejected; boundary and activation costs consume the raw matrix advantage

fixed_pair_prefix.decision: rejected for production; fixed two-entry records are exact but do not improve the CSR shader

fused_ffn_qkv.method: keep 64 hidden and 32 quantized feature values per token, write feature and compute QKV before leaving the shader
fused_ffn_qkv.decision: rejected; register pressure/spilling costs more than the eliminated feature read and dispatch

production_decision: retain the existing sparse prefix and SM6 FP32 FFN; focus on persistent full-network scheduling and other stages
